prompts:
Edit target: the attached active UNDERSTAR Rift Monolith logo. Make a faithful premium high-resolution remaster for the same game, with more authored material detail and mining/celestial flavour. Preserve the exact word UNDERSTAR, all nine correct letters, the distinctive narrow angular heavy serif letter shapes, horizontal single-line composition, existing spacing, charcoal stone faces, thin aged-gold bevels, turquoise mineral fractures, floating rock chips at the sides, and the slender symmetrical underline with its central four-point cyan star. The letters and star must remain extremely readable as a 560-pixel-wide game-menu logo. Do not add any other text, subtitle, symbols, scenery, surrounding badge, or watermark.
Improve the sculptural craft: coherent large fractured basalt plates, crisp chiseled bevel transitions, a few fine fossil/mineral strata and tiny weathered engraved star-map marks inside the stone, restrained natural pores and edge wear, subtle warm metal filigree recessed into selected bevels, narrow luminous cyan ore seams with differentiated depth. The details should feel deliberately carved into ancient subterranean stone. Preserve broad calm dark letter faces so extra texture does not become visual noise. Define the side faces and contact shadows cleanly, with a soft warm overhead key and faint teal light from the mineral seams. Keep gold thin and aged, no chunky shiny gold, and keep cyan glow tightly controlled, no broad bloom. Preserve the pointed angular final R and original star position. The result must feel like the same UNDERSTAR brand, refined with believable depth and superior edge clarity.
Output: one standalone logo on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, with clean semi-transparent antialiased edges and ample small transparent safety padding. No black/white rectangle and no checkerboard baked in. Wide landscape image, target 4096 x 1216 pixels or the highest native resolution available in this wide aspect ratio. The logo should fill roughly 94 percent of the image width, centered and fully visible. This is a detailed redrawn remaster, preserve all original brand invariants.

Edit only the background and framing of this exact UNDERSTAR logo image. Preserve the logo artwork pixel-faithfully: its exact nine letters UNDERSTAR, all stone texture, gold engravings, cyan cracks, bevels, every floating fragment, the full thin underline and white/cyan central star. Replace EVERY white/gray checkerboard background square and all checkerboard in letter holes and empty gaps with one perfectly uniform solid pure saturated magenta chroma-key color RGB 255,0,255 (#ff00ff). This magenta is a technical removable background for a Blender cutout. No checkerboard anywhere. Do not recolor any part of the actual logo, especially white highlights and the white center of the star. No magenta reflected light, no shadow on the background, no background gradient. Crop away the excessive top and bottom blank space: wide 3.36:1 canvas, very tightly framed logo with just 2 percent safety padding on every edge. Preserve the whole final R tip, all side chips and full star tips. Highest native resolution available, target 4096x1216. Nothing else changes.
note: First output baked a checkerboard; the second supplies a magenta extraction background for Blender.
